streams.title: Rail and track-panel fabrication
streams.quantity_basis: two rails, ten seat pairs, alignment layer and plinths

stages.title: Inspect and batch rails
Cast alignment layer and plinth modules
Fit pads, baseplates and fasteners
Place rails and close panel geometry
Trackform, rail, fasteners, welds, and geometry
stages.qa_hold: weld NDT and final geometry release

streams.title: Station kit fabrication and assembly
streams.quantity_basis: controlled standard station product tree and traveler

stages.title: Cast platform and foundation modules
Fabricate canopy portal frames
Build PV roof and MEP cassettes
Station foundations, platform, canopy, and access structure
stages.qa_hold: 350 mm platform/rail datum and structural survey

stages.title: Station MEP, passenger systems, fare, and safety fit-out

streams.title: Viaduct fabrication and erection
streams.quantity_basis: two <=75 t, 2.9 m wide decked pi-beams plus selected foundation, hollow cap, bearings, walkway cassettes and trackform

stages.title: Construct and test foundation, pier column and hollow cap
stages.output: tested foundation, completed pier column and erected hollow cap
stages.qa_hold: actual foundation length/cost, representative load-test release, column records and cap seat survey

stages.title: Prepare Pi-beam mould, cage and tendons
stages.qa_hold: mould, cage, tendon and insert hold point

stages.title: Cast, cure and transfer prestress
Survey and first-article proof
stages.qa_hold: dimensions, camber, cover, NDT and drainage

stages.title: Transport and certify erection system
inputs: portal launcher or crane load chart
stages.output: beam and erection plant released inside envelope
stages.qa_hold: route, radius, rigging, wind and ground-bearing release

stages.title: Set bearings and erect two Pi-beams
stages.output: stable twin-track erected bay after two main lifts
stages.qa_hold: bearing identity/orientation, synchronization and one-line internal-support survey

stages.title: Connect short semi-continuous unit
stages.output: four-span unit structurally connected at internal support

stages.title: Install trackform, egress and containment
stages.qa_hold: track, drainage, earthing and egress release

streams.title: LM3 fabrication and final assembly
streams.quantity_basis: 120 product items, 26 controlled assemblies, one production traveler

stages.title: Trainset material kit and production traveller
stages.output: released kit, trainset traveller, serial traceability sheet

stages.title: Carbody, bogie, wheelset, and brake build
stages.output: accepted carbody shell, bogie set, brake subsystem

stages.title: Fabricate moulded one-metre glass-fibre body modules
stages.output: numbered moulded side and roof module kits released for three-car body installation

stages.title: Install and release three-car clip-on fiberglass exterior body
stages.output: three-car exterior body installed and released without production adhesive cure

stages.title: Traction, battery, onboard control, and comms install
stages.output: powered static trainset with accepted control stack

stages.title: Passenger fit-out, doors, HVAC, and static acceptance
stages.output: fit-out complete trainset ready for dynamic trial

stages.title: Trainset dynamic commissioning and release
stages.output: trainset released for integrated trial running
